//go:build !functional

package metaengine

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "testing"
)

// One-time deliberate fixture capture; never run as an automatic update mode.
func TestExportScopedV4Fixture(t *testing.T) {
 state := scopedCodecFixture()
 prepareScopedFixture(t, &state)
 data, err := json.Marshal(state)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/scoped-v4/snapshot.json", append(data, '\n'), 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 _, collection := collectionProposalFixture(t)
 data, err = Encode(collection)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/scoped-v4/collection-command.json", append(data, '\n'), 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 pending, p := collectionProposalFixture(t)
 result := applyMachine(t, restoreMachineFixture(t, pending), p)
 data, err = json.Marshal(result)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/scoped-v4/collection-result.json", append(data, '\n'), 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
}
